data.title: 矢来美羽 · 雨后的街角
data.description: 雨刚停，街角的积水映出招牌。美羽收起伞，回头确认路口已经恢复通行。
data.action: holding a closed umbrella and looking back at the crossing
data.promptProse: Standing beneath an umbrella on a glistening street corner after a sudden rainstorm, Miu pauses beside pedestrian crosswalk markings, looking back over her shoulder with an amused, sparkling smile. Puddles on the asphalt mirror the clearing pastel sunset sky and illuminated shop signs, while fresh rain mist cleanses the air.
